What Affects Your Final Price?

Every project is unique. Here are the main factors that determine your final cost.

🪵

Material Choice

Wood, vinyl, composite, metal — each material has different costs. We'll help you pick the best option for your budget and style.

⛰️

Terrain & Access

Slopes, rocky soil, and tight access can affect labor. We assess your property during the free on-site estimate.

📐

Style & Height

Privacy fences, decorative styles, and taller builds affect pricing. Gates with specialty hardware adjust cost as well.
